board.title: Page heading of the kanban board. Glossary: pipeline stays 'pipeline' in Polish. 1 word.
board.stagesLink: Top-bar link to the stage editor. Glossary: stage → etap. Plural, ≤1 word.
board.ownerFilterAria: aria-label of the select that filters the board by lead owner. Glossary: owner → opiekun.
board.allOwners: Both the placeholder and the first option of that select — means no filter. ≤2 words.
board.empty.noLeadsYet: Shown in the FIRST column when it has no cards. Glossary: lead stays 'lead' and inflects (leada, leady). ≤3 words.
board.empty.dropHere: Shown in a later column on DESKTOP, where cards are dragged in. Imperative-ish hint, ≤4 words.
board.empty.noLeads: Shown in a later column on MOBILE, where there is no dragging — so it states a fact instead of inviting a drop. ≤2 words.
board.addManually: Small link under the first column's empty state that opens the add-lead dialog. The + glyph stays in markup. ≤4 words.
board.newMail: Accessible name / tooltip for the card-level unread-mail indicator (corner dot + ring on the lead tile). Not a visible chip. Prefer ‘New message’ / Polish ‘Nowa wiadomość’. ≤2 words.
priority.low: Lead priority badge and select option. ≤1 word.
priority.medium: Lead priority badge and select option. ≤1 word.
priority.high: Lead priority badge and select option. ≤1 word.
owner.unassigned: Placeholder and option meaning the lead has no owner yet. ≤1 word. Must read naturally as a select option.
addLead.title: Title of the add-lead dialog. ≤3 words.
addLead.email: Field label. Required — the asterisk is rendered separately. 1 word.
addLead.name: Field label for the lead's name. 1 word.
addLead.value: Field label for the deal amount in money. 1 word — the currency is formatted elsewhere.
addLead.stage: Field label AND aria-label of the stage picker. Glossary: stage → etap. 1 word.
addLead.priority: Field label AND aria-label of the priority picker. 1 word.
addLead.owner: Field label AND aria-label of the owner picker. Glossary: owner → opiekun. 1 word.
addLead.submit: Submit button of that dialog. Imperative, ≤3 words.
addLead.errors.create: Fallback when creating the lead failed and the server gave no message. No trailing period.
leadDetail.closeAria: aria-label of the ✕ that closes the lead side panel. 1 word.
leadDetail.panelAria: Accessible name of the side panel itself, which currently has none. ≤3 words.
leadDetail.comments: Heading above the comment list. PLURAL on {count} — Polish needs three forms.
leadDetail.noComments: Shown when the lead has no comments. One short sentence.
leadDetail.unknownAuthor: Shown in place of a comment author's email when it is missing. ≤1 word.
leadDetail.commentPlaceholder: Placeholder of the new-comment box. Ends with an ellipsis character.
leadDetail.addComment: Button that posts the comment. Imperative, ≤3 words.
leadDetail.addingComment: Label that button shows while posting. Ends with an ellipsis character.
leadDetail.deleteLead: Destructive button in the panel footer. Imperative, ≤2 words.
leadDetail.delete.title: Title of the delete confirmation. A question. Polish: infinitive, e.g. 'Usunąć leada?'.
leadDetail.delete.message: Body of that confirmation. {name} is the lead's title, wrapped in the locale's own quote marks. Say the action cannot be undone. Replaces a sentence that was split across three DOM nodes.
leadDetail.errors.delete: Fallback when deleting the lead failed. No trailing period.
seedStages.newLead: Display name of the first of the five stages a fresh install is seeded with, shown as a Kanban column header and in the stage dropdowns. The database keeps the English seed and is never rewritten in a UI language; this key is used only while the stored name still matches it, so a stage the operator renamed always shows their own words (ADR-0011). These are the names of a LEAD's state, so they read as a progression: nowy lead → spotkanie umówione → negocjacje → wygrany → przegrany. ≤2 words — a column header. Glossary: lead stays 'lead'.
seedStages.meetingSet: Second seeded stage: a meeting with the lead has been arranged, nothing has been negotiated yet. ≤2 words, and it must fit the same column header as the others.
seedStages.negotiation: Third seeded stage: terms are being negotiated. 1 word; Polish naturally uses the plural here.
seedStages.won: Fourth seeded stage: the deal closed successfully. 1 word. Distinct from stages.won, which labels the CHECKBOX that marks any stage as the winning one — this is the seeded stage's own name, so the two keys must not be merged. Polish agrees with 'lead' (masculine).
seedStages.lost: Fifth seeded stage: the deal was lost. 1 word, same agreement and same distinction from stages.lost as above.
stages.title: Page heading of the stage editor. Glossary: stage → etap. ≤2 words.
stages.back: Link back to the board. The ← glyph stays in markup. ≤1 word.
stages.add: Button that opens the new-stage dialog. The + glyph stays in markup. ≤3 words.
stages.namePlaceholder: Placeholder of the stage-name input. ≤2 words.
stages.seedNameHint: Line under the stage-editor heading, explaining something genuinely surprising: the five seeded stages are DISPLAYED translated, while the text input on each row holds the value stored in the database (which is never translated, ADR-0011). So a fresh Polish install shows Polish column headers on the board and the English seed in this editor, and renaming a stage collapses the two. Two sentences, impersonal, no scare wording.
stages.colorAria: aria-label of the colour picker on each stage row and in the dialog. ≤2 words.
stages.won: Checkbox marking the stage as a won deal. ≤1 word, adjective agreeing with 'etap' (masculine) in Polish.
stages.lost: Checkbox marking the stage as a lost deal. ≤1 word, same agreement as stages.won.
stages.moveUpAria: aria-label of that same button — names what moves, unlike the terser tooltip.
stages.thisStage: Fallback used in the delete confirmation when the stage has no name yet. ≤2 words.
stages.delete.title: Title of the stage delete confirmation. Polish: infinitive question.
stages.delete.message: Body of it. {name} is the stage name (or stages.thisStage), wrapped in the locale's own quote marks. Must say the stage's leads move to the FIRST stage — nothing is lost.
stages.delete.confirm: The destructive button. Names the action and the object. ≤3 words.
stages.colors.blue: Name of a colour preset in the stage colour picker. 1 word.
stages.colors.amber: Name of a colour preset. 1 word.
stages.colors.orange: Name of a colour preset. 1 word.
stages.colors.green: Name of a colour preset. 1 word.
stages.colors.red: Name of a colour preset. 1 word.
stages.colors.purple: Name of a colour preset. 1 word.
stages.colors.gray: Name of a colour preset. 1 word.
toast.leadMoved: Toast after dragging a lead to another stage. ≤3 words, past tense.
toast.saved: Toast after editing a lead's fields. ≤2 words, past tense.
toast.commentAdded: Toast after posting a comment. ≤3 words, past tense.
toast.leadCreated: Toast after creating a lead. ≤3 words, past tense.
toast.stageCreated: Toast after creating a stage. ≤3 words, past tense.
toast.stageUpdated: Toast after renaming or recolouring a stage. ≤3 words, past tense.
toast.stageDeleted: Toast after deleting a stage. ≤3 words, past tense.
toast.stagesReordered: Toast after moving a stage up or down. ≤3 words, past tense.
errors.loadBoard: Fallback when the board could not be fetched. No trailing period.
errors.moveLead: Fallback when moving a lead between stages failed. No trailing period.
errors.save: Fallback when saving a lead's fields failed. No trailing period.
errors.addComment: Fallback when posting a comment failed. No trailing period.
errors.createLead: Fallback when creating a lead failed. No trailing period.
errors.deleteLead: Fallback when deleting a lead failed. No trailing period.
errors.createStage: Fallback when creating a stage failed. No trailing period.
errors.updateStage: Fallback when updating a stage failed. No trailing period.
errors.deleteStage: Fallback when deleting a stage failed. No trailing period.
errors.reorderStages: Fallback when reordering stages failed. No trailing period.
leadDetail.titleField: Field label for the lead's own title (editable). 1 word.
leadDetail.formSubmission: Heading above the form submission a lead came from. Glossary: submission → zgłoszenie.
toast.leadDeleted: Toast after deleting a lead. ≤3 words, past tense.
